craft pace.p90: 90th percentile shot 10.1 s, target ≤ 6 s; a long hold has to be a designed one; cut to the listener's face or an insert (hook-02b, hook-04, hook-06, origin-r12-01, origin-01b, origin-budget, origin-sketches, origin-transfer, … 68) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft pace.longest: longest shot 11.2 s, target ≤ 8 s; longer than the shortest clip the pipeline buys (hook-06, origin-budget, origin-transfer, origin-03, idea-14, engine-02, engine-08, engine-10, … 25) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft pace.spread: long shots against short ones (90th ÷ 10th percentile) 2.0, target ≥ 2; every shot the same length is a metronome: a three-to-five-character line for a quick shot, two lines held on one shot before a reveal (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft hook.opening: shots that start in the first 10 s 2, target ≥ 4; open inside the event: place, the lead doing something, the lead's face, the other side's reaction (hook-01, hook-02) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)
craft hook.opening30: shots that start in the first 30 s 6, target ≥ 10; the opening half-minute is where the density goes (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft hook.dialogue: first line spoken by a character never, target ≤ 10 s; let someone in the scene speak first; a retelling with no speaking characters answers this row in the report (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.median: median line length 24 characters, target ≤ 12; people in a scene speak in short turns; break the sentence where the cut goes (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.long: lines over 20 characters 67%, target ≤ 10%; a line this long holds one picture too long; split it across two shots (hook-02b, hook-06, origin-r12-01, origin-01b, origin-budget, origin-sketches, origin-transfer, origin-03, … 63) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.narrator: narration and inner voice, share of the spoken text 100%, target ≤ 35%; turn narration into what a character says or does; keep it for time jumps (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.named: shots that name no shot size 36%, target ≤ 20%; start `camera` with the size: Wide, Medium shot, Medium close-up, Close-up, Insert … (hook-01, origin-sketches, origin-transfer, idea-memory, idea-13b, idea-r12-02, idea-r12-04, turn-cart-board, … 30) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.face: faces (medium close-up and closer, over-the-shoulder) 39%, target ≥ 40%; the audience follows a face; give each turn of the scene a face that reacts (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.insert: inserts 4%, target 5%–25%; an insert answers a story question (which paper, whose hand); too few hides the proof, too many hides the people (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.reestablish: longest run without a wide or group shot 27 shots, target ≤ 9; after a move, an entrance or a new beat, re-establish the room (turn-06, now-passenger) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.look: shots where the only behaviour is a look, a breath or a tremor 100%, target ≤ 33%; reaction shots are needed, a third is the ceiling: elsewhere write what the person does to someone or something (hook-01, hook-02, hook-02b, hook-03, hook-04, hook-06, origin-r12-01, origin-01b, … 84) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.run: such shots in a row 84 shots, target ≤ 2; three looks in a row is three portraits: put an action between them (hook-01, hook-02, hook-02b, hook-03, hook-04, hook-06, origin-r12-01, origin-01b, … 84) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)
